description: Create a model export job by owner/project/model, ul://owner/project/model, or slug with a project (state-changing, may cost credits). The format is validated immediately by the server; task and architecture compatibility is only known when the job runs, so a queued export can still fail. Use export_status and exports_list for the real outcome. Requires confirm_cost=true.

confirm_cost.description: Must be true to allow a credit-costing export job.

format.description: Requested export format (validated by the server).

gpu_type.description: GPU type required for TensorRT engine exports.

model.description: Model ref by owner/project/model, ul:// URI, or slug (requires project).

project.description: Project ref required when model is given by slug.

quantize.description: Export precision. Server-validated; for example 16 or "fp16" for FP16, 8 or "int8" for INT8. Omit to let the exporter choose.

name: export_create
